newsitem.title: UK: Greenalls food, drink sales up in 4 months.
newsitem.headline: Greenalls food, drink sales up in 4 months.

text.p: Greenalls Group Plc said on Friday food and drink sales in its managed pubs and restaurants rose by 5.9 percent in the first four months of the current financial year.
Gaming machines revenue per outlet increased 17.9 percent over the same period compared with a year earlier.

"Like others in our sector, we are cautious at this stage but nevertheless we expect our business to make good progress in the year as a whole," chairman Andrew Thomas told shareholders at their annual meeting.
Trading over Christmas and the New year had been slow but eventually gathered momentum, Thomas said.
At de Vere Hotels, headline room yield rose 15 percent with the like for like yield increasing by nine percent.
Village Leisure achieved an increase in like for like room yield of 10 percent, while Premier Lodge saw a yield rise of eight percent.
Operasting profit at Stretton Leisure was ahead of the same period last year, but the full year result will reflect the sale in December of the cigarette vending business for 6.3 million stg.
G & J Greenall continues to suffer from Russian import restrictions on vodka. Operating profit is therefore well down on last year, Thomas said.
